Title: PASS flow returns COMPLETED and echoes product_id
Steps: 1) Import simulate from digital_twin.simulation.simulator; 2) Call simulate with the test data positionally in DT-002 order; 3) Inspect result.status and result.product_id
Expected Result: result.status == COMPLETED (str comparison); result.product_id == PROD-001
Notes: Unit-level TC-02 asserts only COMPLETED plus all three stations (A-11 resolved). Module path per A-01 resolution.

Title: PASS flow runs exactly three stations in order
Steps: 1) Call simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10); 2) Read the list of station names from result.stations in order
Expected Result: len(result.stations) == 3; station names in order == [Assembly, Inspection, Packaging]
Notes: Asserts the exact station list, not only the total (TR-01.a).

Title: PASS flow station statuses
Steps: 1) Call simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10); 2) Read the status of each station in order
Expected Result: Station statuses in order == [COMPLETED, PASS, COMPLETED]
Notes: Statuses are str-comparable values (resolved).

Title: PASS flow station durations
Steps: 1) Call simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10); 2) Read duration_seconds of each station in order
Expected Result: duration_seconds in order == [30, 0, 10]

Title: PASS flow total simulated time
Steps: 1) Call simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10); 2) Read result.total_simulated_time_seconds
Expected Result: result.total_simulated_time_seconds == 40
Notes: TC-21 level is not stated in the requirements; unit level per DT-002.

Title: PASS result equals the FR-03 example response
Steps: 1) Call simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10); 2) Compare each result attribute and each station attribute (station, status, duration_seconds) with the FR-03 example response field by field
Test Data: Expected: product_id=PROD-001; status=COMPLETED; stations=[(Assembly, COMPLETED, 30), (Inspection, PASS, 0), (Packaging, COMPLETED, 10)]; total_simulated_time_seconds=40
Expected Result: All fields equal the expected values; attribute access is used (no dict or key access)
Notes: Expected values taken from the FR-03 example in the original requirements.

Title: Result and station expose exactly the documented fields (no reason on PASS)
Steps: 1) Call simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10); 2) Use dataclasses.fields on the result and on result.stations[0]; 3) Check hasattr(result, reason)
Expected Result: Result field names == {product_id, status, stations, total_simulated_time_seconds}; station field names == {station, status, duration_seconds}; hasattr(result, reason) is False
Notes: Exact-set check enabled because A-08 is resolved (frozen dataclass, no reason on PASS). Station entries are assumed to follow the same attribute-access style as the result.

Title: Durations and total are integers
Steps: 1) Call simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10); 2) Check type of each station duration_seconds and of total_simulated_time_seconds
Expected Result: Each duration and the total satisfy isinstance(value, int) and are not bool
Notes: Int durations per resolved A-09.

Title: Minimum times (1 s assembly, 1 s packaging)
Steps: 1) Call simulate(PROD-001, 1, PASS, 1); 2) Check station durations and total
Expected Result: duration_seconds in order == [1, 0, 1]; total_simulated_time_seconds == 2
Notes: Unit-level boundary check accepted as an extra case, not a new TC-xx (A-12 resolved).

Title: Maximum times (300 s assembly, 120 s packaging)
Steps: 1) Call simulate(PROD-001, 300, PASS, 120); 2) Check station durations and total
Expected Result: duration_seconds in order == [300, 0, 120]; total_simulated_time_seconds == 420
Notes: Unit-level boundary check (A-12 resolved).

Title: Mixed min/max times map to the correct stations
Steps: 1) Parametrized: call simulate(PROD-001, 1, PASS, 120); 2) Parametrized: call simulate(PROD-001, 300, PASS, 1); 3) Check station durations and total for each
Test Data: Case A: assembly_time_seconds=1; packaging_time_seconds=120. Case B: assembly_time_seconds=300; packaging_time_seconds=1. product_id=PROD-001; inspection_result=PASS
Expected Result: Case A: durations [1, 0, 120] and total 121. Case B: durations [300, 0, 1] and total 301
Notes: Unit-level boundary check (A-12 resolved).

Title: Assembly and packaging times are not swapped
Steps: 1) Parametrized: call simulate(PROD-001, 120, PASS, 5); 2) Parametrized: call simulate(PROD-001, 5, PASS, 120); 3) Check durations and total for each
Test Data: Case A: assembly_time_seconds=120; packaging_time_seconds=5. Case B: assembly_time_seconds=5; packaging_time_seconds=120. product_id=PROD-001; inspection_result=PASS
Expected Result: Case A: durations [120, 0, 5], total 125. Case B: durations [5, 0, 120], total 125
Notes: Equal totals, different durations: detects swapped parameters.

Title: product_id is echoed unchanged
Steps: 1) Parametrized: call simulate with each product_id and (30, PASS, 10); 2) Compare result.product_id with the input
Test Data: Case A: product_id=A (1 character). Case B: product_id=50 repetitions of the letter P. Case C: product_id with one leading and one trailing space around PROD-001
Expected Result: result.product_id equals the input string exactly in every case (no trimming, no truncation)
Notes: Echo unchanged per resolved A-10. Whitespace handling for invalid input belongs to DT-004.

Title: Simulating 300 s assembly does not sleep
Steps: 1) Use monkeypatch to replace time.sleep and asyncio.sleep with functions that raise AssertionError; 2) Call simulate(PROD-001, 300, PASS, 120)
Expected Result: A result with status COMPLETED is returned; neither patched sleep function is called
Notes: Primary no-wait check (A-14 resolved).

Title: Simulating 300 s assembly returns in under 1 s
Steps: 1) Record time.perf_counter(); 2) Call simulate(PROD-001, 300, PASS, 120); 3) Compute elapsed time
Expected Result: Elapsed wall time < 1.0 s
Notes: Secondary check only; 1 s threshold borrowed from NFR-06 and accepted in A-14. Priority set to Medium because TS-DT002-14 is the primary check.

Title: Simulator module imports no clock, random, network, OS or cloud modules
Steps: 1) Read the module source file; 2) Parse it with ast; 3) Collect top-level module names of every Import and ImportFrom node
Test Data: Forbidden top-level modules: time, random, datetime, asyncio, socket, os, boto3, requests, httpx, simpy
Expected Result: The set of imported top-level modules has no intersection with the forbidden list
Notes: List is indicative (A-14); simpy added because no SimPy is used in this story (A-03 resolved).

Title: Simulation needs no AWS credentials
Steps: 1) Use monkeypatch.delenv with raising=False for each AWS variable; 2) Call simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10); 3) Compare with the FR-03 example result
Test Data: Removed variables: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SESSION_TOKEN, AWS_PROFILE, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, AWS_REGION. Input: product_id=PROD-001; assembly_time_seconds=30; inspection_result=PASS; packaging_time_seconds=10
Expected Result: Result equals the expected FR-03 example result (status COMPLETED; durations [30, 0, 10]; total 40)
Notes: No .env or secrets file is read.

Title: Identical input twice gives equal results
Steps: 1) Call simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10) twice; 2) Compare the two results with ==
Expected Result: first == second (frozen dataclass equality: same status, station order, statuses, durations, total)

Title: 100 identical calls give equal results
Steps: 1) Call simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10) 100 times; 2) Compare each result with the first
Expected Result: All 100 results == the first result

Title: No state leaks between different calls
Steps: 1) Call A = simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10); 2) Call B = simulate(PROD-002, 300, PASS, 120); 3) Call A again; 4) Compare results
Test Data: A: product_id=PROD-001; assembly_time_seconds=30; inspection_result=PASS; packaging_time_seconds=10. B: product_id=PROD-002; assembly_time_seconds=300; inspection_result=PASS; packaging_time_seconds=120
Expected Result: Third result == first result; B has product_id PROD-002, durations [300, 0, 120], total 420; B != A

Title: Mutating a returned stations container does not affect later calls
Steps: 1) Call first = simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10); 2) If first.stations is a list, call first.stations.clear() (skip the mutation if it is a tuple); 3) Call second = simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10); 4) Compare second with the expected FR-03 example result
Expected Result: second has 3 stations with durations [30, 0, 10] and total 40, regardless of the mutation of first
Notes: ASSUMPTION (A-08): the container type of stations (list or tuple) is not specified; test tolerates both.

Title: Result model is a frozen dataclass
Steps: 1) Call result = simulate(PROD-001, 30, PASS, 10); 2) Check dataclasses.is_dataclass(result); 3) Attempt result.status = REJECTED
Test Data: product_id=PROD-001; assembly_time_seconds=30; inspection_result=PASS; packaging_time_seconds=10; assigned value=REJECTED
Expected Result: is_dataclass(result) is True; the assignment raises dataclasses.FrozenInstanceError; result.status is still COMPLETED
Notes: Frozen dataclass is a resolved A-08 decision. Reconciles TCOND-21's mutable-result assumption: the result object itself is immutable.

Title: Simulator module does not import the API layer or FastAPI
Preconditions: Python interpreter and package digital_twin installed
Steps: 1) Run a subprocess with sys.executable -c that imports digital_twin.simulation.simulator and prints the sorted names in sys.modules that equal or start with fastapi, starlette, digital_twin.api or app; 2) Check exit code and stdout
Test Data: Module names checked: fastapi, starlette, digital_twin.api, app
Expected Result: Subprocess exit code 0; printed list is empty; no HTTP server or TestClient is started
Notes: Clean interpreter avoids pollution from other tests importing FastAPI.

Title: simulate and result model are fully annotated
Steps: 1) Use inspect.signature(simulate); 2) Check every parameter and the return annotation are not inspect.Parameter.empty; 3) Call typing.get_type_hints on the result dataclass and the station dataclass; 4) Compare with the dataclass field names
Expected Result: Every parameter and the return type are annotated; every dataclass field has a type hint

Title: mypy reports no errors for the simulator module
Preconditions: Virtualenv active with dev dependencies installed
Steps: 1) Run mypy src; 2) Check exit code and output
Expected Result: Exit code 0; no errors reported for src/digital_twin/simulation/simulator.py
Notes: mypy is the type check (A-16 resolved). Run as a CI/local command.

Title: Ruff lint and format checks pass for simulator and its tests
Preconditions: Virtualenv active with dev dependencies installed
Steps: 1) Run ruff check src/digital_twin/simulation/simulator.py tests/simulation/test_simulator.py; 2) Run ruff format --check on the same files
Test Data: Rules: E, F, I, B, UP, SIM; line length 100
Expected Result: Both commands exit with code 0 and report no findings
Notes: Ruff is the lint check (A-16 resolved). NFR-01.c (clear names, small functions) is accepted as code-review evidence and has no test case (A-15 resolved).

Title: Total equals sum of station durations; Inspection always 0
Steps: 1) Parametrize over the time pairs; 2) Call simulate(PROD-001, assembly, PASS, packaging) for each; 3) Compare total with the sum of station durations and check the Inspection duration
Expected Result: total_simulated_time_seconds == assembly + packaging == sum of the three duration_seconds; Inspection duration_seconds == 0 in every case
Notes: Invariant check complementing the exact-value cases TS-DT002-04, 09 to 12.

Title: DT-002 tests still pass after the FAIL flow is added
Steps: 1) Run pytest tests/simulation/test_simulator.py; 2) Confirm none of the DT-002 tests were edited
Expected Result: All DT-002 tests pass unchanged (exit code 0)
Notes: Blocked by DT-003. Regression re-run, no new test code.
